---
title: "Validation Suite"
subtitle: "11 preregistered checkpoints across 7 pipeline stages — all must pass before manuscript preparation"
---

The pipeline enforces a gate-and-proceed model. The `validate_pipeline.py` orchestrator reads all per-stage `*.json` outputs and exits with code 1 if any **critical** checkpoint fails, blocking downstream Nextflow steps.

```{=html}

</div>
```

## Stage 0 — Preregistration Integrity

```{=html}
<div class="test-block pass">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 0 · Global · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Preregistration hash verification</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    The SHA256 hash of the canonical JSON serialization of <code>PREREG</code> must
    match the recorded value in <code>PREREG_HASH</code>. Any modification to
    analysis parameters after hash registration constitutes a preregistration deviation
    and must be declared in the manuscript.
  </p>
  <div style="margin-top:0.6rem;">
    <span class="threshold">SHA256 exact match required</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

**How to set the hash:**

```python
# After finalizing config/preregistration.py:
python3 -c "from config.preregistration import compute_hash; print(compute_hash())"
# → Paste output into PREREG_HASH = "..." in the same file
# → git commit and push
# → Register on OSF/AsPredicted, paste DOI into registration_doi field
```

---

## Stage 1 — Alignment QC

```{=html}
<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 1a · Per-sample · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Spatial barcode mapping rate</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Fraction of post-QC cells with valid puck coordinates (direct match or
    1-Hamming correction). Low rates indicate puck file mismatch, barcode
    degradation, or poor RNA quality.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">≥ 70% cells spatially mapped</span>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 1b · Per-sample · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Velocity-compatible unspliced coverage</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Two metrics from Velocyto output: (1) fraction of genes with detectable
    unspliced counts; (2) median unspliced/spliced ratio. Both must be in range
    for dynamical velocity to be well-estimated.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">≥ 40% genes with unspliced · Median U/S ratio: 0.10–0.40</span>
</div>
```

**Failure remediation:**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Spatial mapping < 70% | Wrong puck file paired to sample | Re-check `sample_sheet.csv` |
| Unspliced < 40% | GTF missing intron annotations | Re-run STAR with `eisar`-generated intron GTF |
| U/S ratio > 0.40 | Genomic DNA contamination | Add DAPI/live-dead sort step; tighten `max_pct_mito` threshold |
| U/S ratio < 0.10 | snRNA degradation; very fast splicing | Consider using `GeneFull` (pre-mRNA) as proxy |

---

## Stage 2 — Seurat QC

```{=html}
<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 2 · Per-sample · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Minimum cell count post-QC</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Per-sample cell count after applying all exclusion criteria (min genes,
    max % mito, min/max counts). Samples below threshold are excluded from
    the merged analysis entirely — not imputed or padded.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">≥ 1,000 cells per sample</span>
</div>
```

**Exclusion criteria** (frozen in `PREREG["exclusion_criteria"]`):

```python
{
    "cells": {
        "min_genes_detected": 200,
        "max_pct_mitochondrial": 20.0,
        "min_counts": 500,
        "max_counts": 25000,      # doublet proxy
    },
    "samples": {
        "min_cells_post_qc": 1000,
        "min_iop_elevation_mmhg": 15,
        "min_spatially_mapped_fraction": 0.70,
    }
}
```

---

## Stage 3 — scVI Validation (7 tests)

All 7 tests must pass. The validation module produces `validation_report.json` with per-test `passed`, `metric`, `threshold`, and `details` fields. The Nextflow `VALIDATE_PIPELINE` process reads this file and blocks downstream steps if any test fails.

```{=html}
<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Test 1 · Posterior predictive check · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Count distribution fidelity</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    For a random subset of 1,000 genes: draw 100 posterior samples from the
    scVI model and compare each gene's predicted distribution to observed
    counts via 2-sample KS test. Genes pass if KS p > 0.05.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">≥ 50% of tested genes pass (KS p > 0.05)</span>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Test 2 · Batch silhouette · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Batch correction quality</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Compute silhouette scores for <em>batch labels</em> (should be low — batches
    mixed) and <em>cell type labels</em> (should be preserved — cell types separated)
    in the scVI latent space. A combined score captures the tradeoff.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">bio_silhouette − batch_silhouette &gt; 0.5</span>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Test 3 · Reconstruction accuracy · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Expression recovery</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    For 200 randomly sampled cells: compare scVI-imputed normalized expression
    to observed counts (normalized to 10,000) via Spearman correlation.
    Low median r suggests the model has collapsed or underfits.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">Median Spearman r &gt; 0.4 across HVGs</span>
  <div style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:0.82rem;color:#9ba8bc;">
    <strong style="color:#f5c842;">Remediation:</strong> Increase <code>n_latent</code> to 50–100. The default 30 may be insufficient for 20-sample datasets spanning 4 disease timepoints.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Test 4 · Marker preservation · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Known retinal marker gene DE</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    For each cell type × marker gene pair: test whether the marker remains
    significantly differentially expressed in its expected cell type vs. all others
    post-integration (Mann-Whitney U, adj. p &lt; 0.01, log₂FC > 0.5).
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">≥ 70% of marker-cell_type pairs preserved</span>
  <div style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:0.82rem;color:#9ba8bc;">
    <strong style="color:#f5c842;">Remediation:</strong> Add major cell types to <code>categorical_covariate_keys</code>. scVI may otherwise absorb cell-type variance into the batch correction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Test 5 · Velocity compatibility · NON-CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">scVelo readiness</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Run scVelo stochastic velocity on the scVI neighbor graph as a pre-flight check.
    Mean velocity confidence &lt; 0.7 indicates the spliced/unspliced ratio is
    too noisy for VelocityKernel in CellRank.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">Mean velocity confidence &gt; 0.7 · Mean velocity length &gt; 0.1</span>
  <div style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:0.82rem;color:#9ba8bc;">
    <strong style="color:#f5c842;">Fallback:</strong> If this test fails, substitute <code>PseudotimeKernel</code> for <code>VelocityKernel</code> in CellRank. Declare the substitution as a preregistration deviation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Test 6 · Stability · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Seed stability (5 independent runs)</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Train scVI five times with different random seeds. Cluster each latent
    representation with k-means (k = 15). Compute pairwise adjusted Rand
    index across all seed pairs. Low ARI indicates the model is not learning
    stable structure.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">Mean pairwise ARI &gt; 0.8</span>
  <div style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:0.82rem;color:#9ba8bc;">
    <strong style="color:#f5c842;">Note:</strong> This is the slowest test (~5× training time). Use <code>--skip_t6_stability</code> during development and enable for the final registered run.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Test 7 · Biological validation · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Three biological sub-checks</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Sub-check 7a: AUROC &gt; 0.7 for RGC and Müller glia markers in annotated clusters.<br>
    Sub-check 7b: Reactive gliosis markers (Gfap, Vim, Lcn2) increase baseline → late.<br>
    Sub-check 7c: Trem2 enrichment near ONH in spatially-mapped cells (Mann-Whitney p &lt; 0.05).
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">≥ 60% of sub-checks pass</span>
</div>
```

## Stage 4 — Velocity QC

```{=html}
<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 4 · NON-CRITICAL (fallback available)</div>
  <div class="test-title">Dynamical velocity model fit quality</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Reads <code>velocity_qc.json</code> produced by scVelo. Mean velocity confidence
    and length are computed after dynamical model fitting (more stringent than the
    pre-flight stochastic check in scVI Test 5).
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">Mean velocity confidence &gt; 0.7 · Mean velocity length &gt; 0.1</span>
</div>
```

---

## Stage 5 — CellRank

```{=html}
<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 5a · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Kernel weights locked before fate extraction</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Verifies that <code>kernel_weights.json</code> exists and contains a numeric
    <code>locked_velocity_weight</code>. The validation orchestrator also checks
    that this file's modification timestamp precedes <code>fate_adata.h5ad</code>.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">File exists with numeric locked_velocity_weight</span>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 5b · Per terminal state · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Terminal state recovery AUROC</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Cells labeled as a terminal state by marker criteria should have high fate
    probability for that state. AUROC quantifies how well fate probabilities
    discriminate labeled terminal cells from all others.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">AUROC &gt; 0.75 per terminal state</span>
</div>
```

### Expected terminal states

| State | Up-regulated markers | Down-regulated markers |
|---|---|---|
| `RGC_apoptotic` | Casp3, Casp9, Bax, Atf3, Sox11 | Rbpms, Thy1, Sncg, Pou4f1 |
| `Muller_reactive` | Gfap, Vim, Lcn2, Osmr, Stat3 | Rlbp1, Glul, Clul1 |
| `Microglia_DAM` | Trem2, Apoe, Lpl, Cst7, Cd68 | P2ry12, Cx3cr1, Tmem119, Sall1 |
| `Astrocyte_reactive_ONH` | Gfap, Serpina3n, C3, Lcn2 | Aldh1l1, Glul, S100b |

## Stage 6 — Spatial Statistics

```{=html}
<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 6a · NON-CRITICAL (outcome reporting)</div>
  <div class="test-title">Primary endpoint significance</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Mann-Whitney U result for RGC apoptotic fate Moran's I: mid vs baseline.
    This checkpoint reports the primary endpoint result — it does not block the
    pipeline regardless of outcome. Significance is reported as-is.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">Reported; p_adj &lt; 0.05 is preregistered significance level</span>
</div>

<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 6b · CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Spatial permutation validity</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Verifies that permutation-based Moran's I p-values are non-degenerate
    (not all identical, which would indicate a permutation bug). Checks that
    ≥ 50% of computed p-values are unique.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">≥ 50% unique p-values across all Moran's I tests</span>
</div>
```

## Stage 7 — Targets

```{=html}
<div class="test-block">
  <div class="test-id">Checkpoint 7 · NON-CRITICAL</div>
  <div class="test-title">Therapeutic target table completeness</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#9ba8bc;margin:0.5rem 0;">
    Verifies that <code>therapeutic_targets.csv</code> was produced with the
    required columns. Non-critical because a failed OpenTargets query (e.g., API
    downtime) produces partial but still usable results.
  </p>
  <span class="threshold">File present · gene, composite_score, n_lineages, tier1_tractability columns present</span>
</div>
```

---

## Validation Report Output

Running `validate_pipeline.py` produces two files:

- `pipeline_validation_report.json` — machine-readable, suitable for automated CI
- `pipeline_validation_report.txt` — human-readable summary

```
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PIPELINE VALIDATION SUMMARY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  Passed: 11/11
  Critical failures: 0
  Status: ✅ PROCEED
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

::: {.callout-tip}
**CI integration.** The validation orchestrator exits with code 0 (proceed) or 1 (blocked). This means you can add it as a Nextflow step with `errorStrategy 'terminate'` and treat a clean run as a green CI signal before committing results to the manuscript analysis directory.
:::
